# 7 Cups

> > 7 Cups is a free online mental health support platform combining peer support, licensed therapy, and community resources to make emotional wellness accessible to millions globally.

7 Cups operates the world's largest peer support network with 70+ million community members, offering free emotional support through trained volunteer listeners alongside affordable licensed therapy. The platform has won multiple awards for innovation in online mental health services, including recognition for therapy accessibility, support for specific conditions, and group therapy offerings.

## Core Services

- [7 Cups | Free Online Mental Health Support; Therapy & Counseling](https://www.7cups.com): 7 Cups homepage offering free mental health support, therapy, and counseling services
- [Online Therapy with Licensed Therapists | Simple & Easy Counseling](https://www.7cups.com/online-therapy): 7 Cups online therapy with licensed therapists offering video and messaging counseling
- [An Online Community for Mental Health Support | 7 Cups](https://www.7cups.com/community): 7 Cups community forum for peer support groups and mental health discussions
- [7 Cups Solutions for Organizations](https://www.7cups.com/solutions): 7 Cups organizational solutions for employee mental health and wellness benefits
